unit.why: A single narrative: a melamed buys three sayings from the young Berdichever rebbe for his savings, and each saying saves him on his journey home.

stories.start_quote: בימי עלומיו של הרה״ק מברדיטשוב בא לפניו
stories.end_quote: במותר המעות אשר נשאר עוד בידו
stories.summary_en: A poor melamed, returning home after twelve years with 900 roubles, pays the young R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev 300 for each of three sayings: take the right-hand road, an old man with a young wife is half dead, believe only what you see. Each saying proves true on the way: he recovers stolen goods and is rewarded, he saves an old innkeeper from a murder plot by his young wife, and he does not wrongly condemn his own wife, whose nightly visitor turns out to be their son held as a pledge by the nobleman.
